name: Wisp, the dream cat

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), chapter 22: the Sphinx of Lore's block made Chaotic Evil, Gargantuan and Fey. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.summary: No magic can see it from afar or read its thoughts without its leave; Insight checks to read it have Disadvantage.
traits.text: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.summary: Three times a day (four in its lair), a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead: three times a day, or four in its lair.

actions.name: Mind-Rending Roar
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. A roar heard 300 ft around: each enemy makes a DC 16 Wis save or takes 10d6 Psychic and is Incapacitated until the sphinx's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Int, DC 16: minor utility magic at will; Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse and Tongues once a day each.
actions.text: Intelligence is its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16), needing no Material components. At will: Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation. 1/day each: Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues.

options.name: Arcane Prowl
options.summary: Teleports up to 30 ft to a space it can see, then makes one Claw attack.

options.name: Weight of Years
options.summary: DC 16 Con save by a creature within 120 ft or 1 Exhaustion level, and it looks 3d10 years older; not again until the sphinx's next turn.
options.text: Constitution saving throw, DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: the target gains 1 Exhaustion level, and while it has any Exhaustion it appears 3d10 years older. Either way, the sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

summary: Wisp as the nightmare makes her: a gargantuan grinning cat whose head and paws reach in from the shelf's edge. Vanishes at 0 Hit Points.
